content.text: United Airlines NYC Half United Airlines New York City Half Marathon 2027 The United Airlines New York City Half Marathon is a very popular half marathon. Starting in Brooklyn, crossing the Brooklyn Bridge and heading through Times Square, Manhattan before finishing in Central Park, the United Airlines NYC Half takes you on a wonderful journey through the closed New York City streets. Attracting more than 24,000 runners from across the globe, demand for places is high but as official tour operator for this event you do not need to wait or worry about the lottery process, instead we can guarantee your place on a first-come-first-served basis! Marathon Tours & Travel also offer a 3-night package staying deluxe accommodation, located in the heart of Manhattan, Times Square and within easy reach of the course. As part of our expertly created packages, we include opportunities for you to take part in activities with fellow runners such as a welcome reception with drinks and snacks, escorted race number pick-up, warm-up run, escorted journey towards official race transportation to the start and post-race celebrations. Plus, the Marathon Tours & Travel Team will be on hand for guidance and support throughout, cheering you on! If you book your United Airlines NYC Half package through Marathon Tours & Travel, you will also receive preferential treatment at the start area with drinks and a small breakfast while you wait in the warm, under cover. Unfortunately, we cannot sell race entry to full time residents of USA. If you reside in North America and are Seven Continents Club® Members please contact our USA office to book. If you reside in Australia please contact our Australian office. New York has plenty to see and do. Our accommodation is in an excellent location and is very conveniently located to the heart of Manhattan and all the sights and sounds. The itinerary below reflects the 3 nights package. Adding extra nights is recommended and allows you the time to enjoy the city. Arrival Day & Welcome Reception Welcome to New York! Your Marathon Tours & Travel (MTT) team look forward to meeting you upon your arrival at the Hyatt Centric Times Square. Once you have checked in, the afternoon is yours to enjoy. Details regarding the United Airlines NYC Half Expo and bib pickup will be shared once available. We will look forward to seeing you this evening at our Welcome Reception. (Two drinks + light bites included) Saturday 13 March 2027 Hide details Shake-out run & Expo We start the day with an optional shakeout run through Central Park. The rest of the day is yours to explore the city or relax before the big day. From attending a Broadway show to visiting one of NYC’s observation decks there is no shortage of ways to enjoy St. Patrick’s Day weekend here in the ‘Big Apple’. Enjoy dinner on your own this evening at one of the many local restaurants. Sunday 14 March 2027 Hide details United Airlines NYC Half & Celebrations Luck of the Irish, it’s race day! This will be an early morning with an MTT escort in official race day transportation to the start where you will warmup in the VIP area with light breakfast and private toilet facilities. The United Airlines NYC Half starts in Brooklyn and passes through famous landmarks such as the Brooklyn Bridge, Times Square and Grand Central Station, before finishing at Central Park in Manhattan. Following the race, make your way back on your own to the hotel (approximately a 15-minute walk). Enjoy some well-deserved rest before we gather for a celebratory toast in the hotel lobby bar. The rest of the evening is free to experience one of the many fine restaurants in the city and enjoy some St. Patrick’s Day celebrations! (Two drinks + light bites included) Monday 15 March 2027 Hide details Departure Day Unless you have booked extra nights please check out of your room this morning. Safe travels and we hope you enjoyed your United Airlines New York City Half Marathon 2026 experience! Itinerary is subject to change. Event Information Enter the United Airlines New York City Half Marathon with Marathon Tours & Travel We are very pleased to offer you guaranteed entry into this iconic half marathon, as Marathon Tours & Travel are proud to be an official International Tour Operator. The Course Runners will begin their journey on Prospect Park’s Center Drive in Brooklyn before taking the race onto Brooklyn’s streets. The course will take runners over the Brooklyn Bridge and up the FDR Drive before a crosstown dash on 42nd Street and a turn north on 7th Avenue, through Times Square and into Central Park. Race Time: from 07:00am in waves Minimum Pace/Cut-off Time Policy: 3 hours. Participants need to maintain a 13:45 mile pace throughout the race to avoid cut-off at certain points. Eligibility: Marathon Tours & Travel, an authorised tour operator, is required to offer travel arrangements in conjunction with guaranteed race entry. All runners must be 18 years or older on race day to be eligible for our guaranteed entries. Number Pickup: You must pick up your race bib and packet at the Registration & Expo prior to race day. Temperature: Average temperatures range between 8C to 16C (46F to 60F). Awards: Every finisher receives a T-Shirt & Medal. Difficulty: Easy. Registration & Booking Conditions of Sale Please note we cannot sell race entry without accommodation package. Race entry and associated race elements are not refundable. If you wish to make any changes to your reservations, administration and/or service fees might apply. For our general T&C’s please see here. How to Book during the pre-booking before package release stage To pre-register, click on the book now button, ensuring that you select the correct number of runners. Please read all the important information. If you have any questions please contact us. Whilst we expect this event to take place on the date shown the exact date will only be announced later. Do not book any flights until confirmed details are known and we have advised you of the package choices. How to Book after package options are released. Our team will contact you, advise packages choices with prices and invite you to booking a specific package. At this stage you will need select the correct number of rooms and types for all members in your party plus all the required extras. When you book, we will require a further deposit. Payments When you confirm your booking, we will take a deposit payment. Subsequent payments are taken automatically. Travel advice Before you travel, check the ‘Entry requirements’ section for USA’s current entry restrictions and requirements. Travel Insurance We strongly recommend travellers to take out comprehensive travel insurance with sufficient healthcare cover. Make sure that you are insured for existing medical conditions, any activities you plan to do and any equipment that you plan to take. Travel insurance covers you if anything doesn’t go to plan before you travel as well, so we recommend sorting it at the time of booking. For more information, click here. Credit card All hotels in New York need a credit card imprint upon check in where a value is held and released when you check out. Any incidentals such as room service or chargeable extras to the room would be deducted. Security Policy Marathon Tours & Travel’s security policy requires that anyone staying in our room block must be registered as part of our package. If a registered client attempts to house a non-registered guest and/or invite them to attend any of our scheduled activities, the registered guest’s tour package will be forfeited and parties may be denied access to future tours. Please note that no exceptions will be made as this policy will be strictly enforced. Race Rules and Terms of Participation Our itinerary and details regarding the race are based on current information available at the time this package was released for sale. Whilst we expect the details to remain correct, changes are possible and will be confirmed nearer to the trip after the race organisers have confirmed final instructions. All race rules and procedures need to be followed. More details can be found here. Starting Pens and Bib Numbers Although we are licensed to sell official entries for the United Airlines Half, we have no influence over the allocation of starting times and bib numbers. Closer to the event we will send you a link which will allow you to complete the registration process for the event. Once you have finalised the registration process, the race organisers will allocate you a starting time and bib based on the information provided. Please read the race rules and terms for participation carefully, as you have to accept them to participate in the event. New York Destination Guide Get ready to race in one of the most iconic cities in the world! If you think of busy cities, you can’t not think of New York and the Big Apple has plenty to offer visitors both before and after their race. Read our New York destination guide. Seven Continents Club ® The Seven Continents Club (SCC) offers a unique opportunity for runners to run on all seven continents of the globe, as well as providing numerous benefits to its members. The club operates as a global frequent traveller club for runners, offering waitlist priority for high-demand events, early pre-registration periods for a number of races in popular destinations and tour package vouchers for money off international tour packages. What’s more, Seven Continents Club rewards all its members for the extraordinary achievement of running marathons on each continent with their own special finishers medal and certificate of completion.
